candidateDataset.adult: 38 columns USmen3.5..22, USwomen5..23.5, UK, EU, CM/JP, foot length inches
candidateDataset.child: Big kids13 columns1Y..7Y; little kids15 columns8C..3Y; baby/toddler10 columns1C..10C
candidateDataset.scope: These are inspected source facts, not a cleared deployable chart asset. No manufacturer prose/artwork/code is needed.
candidateDataset.observedMissingRegion: No CN column. CM/JP is a nominal label and differs from foot length; multiplying either by10 does not establish a verified China conversion.
criticalAmbiguities: UK6 maps to both USmen6.5/EU39 and USmen7/EU40; reverse lookups must return both source matches.
Nominal USmen3.5 and kids3.5Y share regional size labels, but adult chart foot length8.5in differs from big-kids chart8.75in. Keep chart group explicit.
Adult chart includes a USwomen column, but that does not prove it matches every women-specific product/chart.
Infant age values are rough chart guidance, not an exact measurement-to-size law; do not calculate fit from age.

rights.verification: US terms endpoint returned403 through web tool. No open commercial data licence identified. Do not substitute Hong Kong terms as verified US terms or claim permission.
rights.nextStep: Establish a reuse basis or choose an appropriately licensed independent sizing dataset. Named-chart attribution does not itself establish permission; no legal clearance conclusion offered.

implementationIfDataCleared: Accept a selected brand/chart-group and source-size system. Exact row lookup, not formula interpolation.
Return all matches if a source label repeats. No matching row means unsupported; do not extrapolate at large/small sizes.
For measured foot length use the selected chart’s measurement row and documented between-size rule; distinguish numeric labels from physical lengths.
Keep supplied-chart data separate from generic length-unit conversion.

safeUserInputAlternative.name: Custom sizing chart lookup
safeUserInputAlternative.behavior: User pastes a chart they can use; validate finite nonnegative physical lengths, preserve C/Y suffixes, and perform exact text matching. Missing columns remain unavailable. Repeated keys return all matches.

parity: Generic foot-length conversion and custom charts are useful local alternatives but do not close all named regional/adult/child/infant presets.

implementationUpdate.note: Earlier research retained as historical evidence. Use the linked update and remaining-mode audit for current implementation and limits.
